caption:
A 22-mile stone wall guards Belfast's water 💧
The Mourne Wall was hand-built in granite between 1904 and 1922 and links the summits of 15 mountains, marking a 9,000-acre catchment for Silent Valley and Ben Crom reservoirs. Silent Valley's dam (1923–1933) took 2,000 local workmen, and the 56 km Mourne Conduit carries the water to Belfast.

Where does your water come from? Comment your town 👇
